column1: # European Portuguese glossary (values-pt). Claude-only proposal, drafted 2026-11-05 alone by Claude, pending the three-vendor debate; not final.
# Same columns as en.tsv: term holds the Portuguese, forms separated by " | ". Definitions are D3's where D3 changed them.

# Rows D3 retires stay, mapped to the chosen term, until D3 merges and en.tsv drops them. D3's new rows (and renamed ids) wait in l10n/pending/glossary-d3/pt-PT.tsv until then, because the loader refuses ids en.tsv lacks.

# HOLD until D3 merges: en.tsv and the strings still use Top speed and Maximum speed in their old senses, while the top-speed and maximum-speed rows below already use D3's. Following those rows now would call the setting Velocidade de ponta and the measured value Velocidade máxima, the swap section 7 of the style guide forbids.

# So do not draft or merge these keys before D3: dashboard_model_tile_top_speed, controls_experimental_speed_limit, the readings_maximum_speed_kmh ladder (with _short and _compact), and main_speed_* if they arrive first. They stay English (council verdict fallback). pack.py has no per-key filter, so a run over those areas must rule them out by hand. Other keys with these terms already match D3.
